widgets.reason.jail_help.value: Repair requires a rooted TV and Homebrew Channel access. See github.com/tiper/fin-native/blob/main/docs/native-video-sandbox.md for help.

widgets.panel.jail.value: this install's sandbox blocks access to /dev/rtkmem; FinNative can offer a confirmed repair through rooted Homebrew Channel access
widgets.panel.jail.description: Playback verdict line: the install's sandbox blocks the video-plane device node.

widgets.repair.body.value: Use Homebrew Channel’s root access to update FinNative’s sandbox with LG’s native profile. This requires a rooted TV. Close and reopen FinNative afterward.

widgets.repair.reopen.value: Close and reopen FinNative before playing video.

widgets.repair.start_failed.value: Could not start the repair. Close and reopen FinNative to try again.

widgets.tracks.enh_note_burn.value: Subtitles stay on. Your server will rework the video to keep them, so the picture may look a little softer.
widgets.tracks.enh_note_burn.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line note under the ENABLED Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when the subtitle on screen is embedded in the file — turning the toggle on makes the server re-encode the video to keep it in view. No jargon: never say burn/re-encode/transcode.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_analyzed.value: Not ready for this video yet. Your server needs to scan its sound first.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_analyzed.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when the carried audio track has no canNormalizeLoudness fact yet.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_refused.value: Your server couldn't turn this on for this video.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_refused.description: Issue #266/M7. One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows after this playback's server already refused or ignored the params once.

widgets.menu.quality_converted_note.value: Your Jellyfin server is converting this video.
widgets.menu.quality_converted_note.description: One-line sub-label under the checked entry of the player's Quality page when the Quality row reports a conversion the viewer did not pick by name ('Original · Converted', 'Auto · 720p'). Always the same neutral sentence; it names no cause.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_converting.value: Not available while your Jellyfin server converts this video.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_converting.description: One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows whenever the Quality row reads 'Original · Converted' (Original picked, the server converting the video). Same fact as that row.

widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_copyable.value: Your Jellyfin server can't add this to this video right now.
widgets.tracks.enh_reason_not_copyable.description: One-line reason under the DISABLED (dim) Boost dialog / Normalize loudness rows when Original quality is in force (or cannot be reached by picking it) but the video cannot be offered the enhancement as it plays: a relay link, a video the server must convert, a track pick the Original route could not follow. Deliberately generic: the viewer cannot act on the differences.
